name: inspect_android_method
description: Decompile one Android method with smali fallback. Requires explicit overload_index when multiple methods share a name. Reports its DEX prototype, representation, fallback markers and source truncation; display signatures may be aliases. Optional mapping_path adds R8/ProGuard mapped names for the class and selected method without replacing observed names. Prefer detail summary to retain complete Evidence and return the selected body and annotations without repeating raw class metadata. Omitted or complete detail preserves complete inline Evidence.
